images.filename: J-PARC Materials and Life Science Experimental Facility Experimental Hall No. 1.jpg
images.caption:
Experimental Hall No. 1 of the Materials and Life Science Facility, of the J-PARC (Japan Proton Accelerator Research Complex).  Neutron experiment instruments are laid out radially from the neutron source, which is located behind the cylindrical wall in the left part of this photograph.  Neutron is generated by collision of the proton beam to the mercury target.
Photographed on 2016 Open House day.

images.filename: J-PARC Neutrino Experiment Facility Primary Beamline Final Focusing Section.jpg
images.caption:
Final Focusing Section of the Neutrino Experiment Facility of J-PARC (Japan Proton Accelerator Complex).  It creates high-intensity neutrino beam for T2K experiment.
Proton beam is led to the graphite target behind the wall in the left center of this picture. The target will generate various particles including π-mesons, which is led to the decay volume where they decay into muon and muon-neutrino.

Photographed on 2016 Open House day.
